reviews.title: Great 32" 4K
reviews.comment: Love the size, the brightness, contrast and resolution. It fits perfectly on my desk and allows me to multitask much better than I was before. I'm actually about to buy a second one, because I like this monitor so much.
reviews.author: TrentB

reviews.title: Great workstation monitor
reviews.comment: Great monitor with crisp display, perfect size for my workstation, easily set up.  And very happy with quick shipping, arrived faster than I thought possible.
